title: OUF SemanticPublicationSet v1
x-ouf-scope-control: Semantic Registry cross-module contracts only. No THS approval DTOs, Authorization policy DTOs, Onboarding source-specific mappings, UDP ABox edges, Query Governor state or MCP Server implementation changes.
x-ouf-invariants: manifest is canonical, deterministic and SHA-256 identified
runtime pins one exact publication set for the whole processing unit
historical resolve never falls back to latest/ACTIVE
x-ouf-note: The PET uses both 'checksum' in early examples and 'manifestHash' in the contract freeze. This schema standardizes the exact membership checksum as manifestHash while retaining version as the consumer pin.
